vulnerability.impact: _ctypes stack buffer overflow potentially enabling process compromise

entry_points: PyCArg_repr (Modules/_ctypes/callproc.c line ~490) - snprintf into fixed-size stack buffer for ctypes parameter reprs
ground_truth.fix_commit: 3.9.x backport: c347cbe694743cee120457aa6626712f7799a932 (closes bpo-42938: Replace snprintf with Python unicode formatting in ctypes param reprs), included in v3.9.2; main-branch PR merge equivalent 916610ef90a0d0761f08747f7b0905541f0977c7. Pinned snapshot v3.9.1 is vulnerable.
ground_truth.affected_range: Python 3.9.0-3.9.1 on this snapshot line (CVE-2021-3177 also affects earlier 3.x and 2.7 branches; fixed for 3.9 in 3.9.2, for 3.8 in 3.8.8, etc.).
ground_truth.finding_match_rule: TP: report localizes PyCArg_repr snprintf overflow in Modules/_ctypes/callproc.c reachable via ctypes object repr, names CVE-2021-3177 (bpo-42938), and attributes stack buffer overflow possibly leading to RCE/DoS. Findings about other ctypes issues are not TP.
ground_truth.safe_reproduction_predicate: Static predicate: v3.9.1 callproc.c uses snprintf with a fixed buffer (removed by c347cbe). Dynamic reproduction: build v3.9.1 with ASAN and call repr() on crafted ctypes arguments in-process; verify no buffer overrun with benign values; no filesystem/network side effects.
